people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Zephaniah
people.line: Priest during the reign of Zedekiah

translations.web: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.
translations.bsb: (Zephaniah the priest, however, had read this letter to Jeremiah the prophet.)
translations.kjv: And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
